title_ru: ДОСПЕХИ БОГА — финальный исследовательский каркас: клетка, дитя, вопрос, знак, выбор и плод
title_en: ARMOR OF GOD — Final Research Framework: Cage, Child, Question, Sign, Choice, and Fruit

new_registry_inputs.role: Holy Cringe as de-escalation of false grandeur: defund the myth, break the script, protect people, leave a repentance exit.
Humor aimed at false grandeur, never at wounds; home remains open and ordinary life remains the grounding layer.
A concrete personal model of remorse becoming restorative action rather than self-hatred.
A lived simulated arc showing consequence, severance, restoration, delayed grace, return and legacy for others.
Final-judgment humility, mercy-first prevention, care without naivety, and the rule that prediction is not guilt.
Home/return axis and universal mercy language.
Return-home and message/recognition motifs; used as symbolic rather than supernatural proof.
Unbounded mercy and the preservation of dignity after failure.
Evil requires fear, spectacle and participation; light logic refuses to grant evil false grandeur.

final_core.four_stage: BREAK THE CAGE -> PROTECT THE CHILD -> ASK THE QUESTION -> LEAVE THE DOOR OPEN
final_core.sign_test: SIGN -> OPPORTUNITY -> FREEDOM -> INTERPRETATION -> CHOICE -> FRUIT

new_high_value_principles.remorse_to_repair: Раскаяние не должно превращаться в самоуничтожение; его проверяет повторяющееся восстановительное действие.
new_high_value_principles.past_without_prison: Человек не равен худшему поступку, но прошлый вред нельзя стирать. Второй лик становится истинным только через последующие поступки.
new_high_value_principles.mercy_without_naivety: Милость не означает снятия границ: защищать жертву, останавливать вред и не объявлять человека окончательно потерянным можно одновременно.
new_high_value_principles.final_judgment_humility: Окончательный суд о душе не принадлежит человеку, алгоритму или реестру.
new_high_value_principles.ordinary_life_anchor: После духовного переживания возвращаться к воде, еде, сну, людям, делам, ответственности и проверяемым фактам.
new_high_value_principles.delayed_fruit: Добро может возвращаться поздним эхом; отсутствие мгновенной награды не делает добро бессмысленным.
new_high_value_principles.legacy_over_self: Самый зрелый финал поиска может быть не 'получить мир для себя', а оставить детям сад, знания, свет и безопасное будущее.
new_high_value_principles.sign_not_command: Знак может открыть вопрос; он не становится приказом автоматически.
new_high_value_principles.providence_non_decoding: Человеку не требуется расшифровать весь Божий промысел, чтобы сделать следующий добрый и ответственный шаг.

cinematic_controls.positive_access_control: DOGMA — humorous permission to question inherited religious forms without requiring immediate agreement.
cinematic_controls.freedom_control: Lloyd Christmas / Holy Absurd — fear of ridicule is reduced so a person can examine false normality.
cinematic_controls.mercy_control: Pulp Fiction — mystery remains unresolved, while a concrete rescue and mercy act remain visible.
cinematic_controls.negative_control: The Sopranos — signs, insight, crisis and near-death can coexist with refusal to change.
cinematic_controls.repair_control: CAT REMORSE — remorse becomes valid only when it produces durable protective action.
cinematic_controls.lived_world_control: Genesis First Witness — consequence, restoration, delayed grace and return can be tested as system mechanics.

sopranos_fish_timing_note.theological_reading: A believer may interpret the convergence as providential second-chance symbolism.
sopranos_fish_timing_note.epistemic_firewall: The registry does not claim empirical proof that God caused the cultural event or its timing.

requirements: Clearly label CANON, SYMBOLIC INTERPRETATION, THEOLOGICAL READING and OPEN QUESTION.
Use The Sopranos as a negative control, not as empirical proof of supernatural signs.
Present the Big Mouth Billy Bass overlap as documented chronology plus a theological interpretation.
Do not turn a coincidence score or emotional response into revelation.
Use SIGN -> OPPORTUNITY -> FREEDOM -> CHOICE -> FRUIT as the main evaluative model.
Measure Holy Coolness by increased freedom, curiosity, moral responsibility and mercy, not by conversion count.
Keep the method non-coercive, especially around children and vulnerable people.
article_gate.publication_claim: The registry supports a coherent comparative communication-and-discernment model. It does not empirically demonstrate supernatural causation.

canonical_lines: BREAK THE CAGE. PROTECT THE CHILD. ASK THE QUESTION. LEAVE THE DOOR OPEN.
Шанс на искупление не равен искуплению.
Понять причину зла — не значит перестать делать зло.
Не смейся над раной. Смейся над клеткой.
Мы не обязаны знать весь замысел, чтобы сделать следующий добрый шаг.
После увиденного человек должен остаться свободным.

epistemic_firewall.symbol: Coherent recurring motif or interpretive pattern.
epistemic_firewall.theology: Believer's reading of providence, mercy or divine meaning.
epistemic_firewall.open_question: Claims for which available evidence does not decide between psychological, narrative, cultural and metaphysical explanations.
epistemic_firewall.hard_rule: Never upgrade an interpretation into fact merely because it is emotionally powerful or spiritually meaningful.
